title: Centre for Regions, Trade & Geopolitics - Home
gist: Landing page of the WEF Centre for Regions, Trade and Geopolitics listing trade-facilitation, European competitiveness, humanitarian investing and forced-labour data initiatives; promotional.

insights.claim: The Centre's initiatives include European Leaders for Growth and Competitiveness, the Global Alliance for Trade Facilitation supporting WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement implementation in developing countries, and a Global Data Partnership Against Forced Labour.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
entities: European Leaders for Growth and Competitiveness
Global Data Partnership Against Forced Labour

insights.claim: Partners of the Humanitarian and Resilience Investing Initiative announced over 50 commitments that could unlock over $15 billion, and the Forum has piloted sustainable FDI facilitation in Cambodia, Ghana, Kenya and India.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Self-reported private-capital mobilisation for frontier markets.
